subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose resetSessionEntryLifecycle and the harness reset hook as the supported Plugin SDK contract for external lifecycle boundaries?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent and proven, but review automation cannot decide whether this broad public ownership contract is the desired long-term API rather than a narrower bundled-plugin or core-internal seam.

options.title: Adopt the generic contract
options.body: Approve the documented owner-coordinated reset API and merge once the remaining exact-head checks finish successfully.

options.title: Narrow the public surface
options.body: Keep the atomic owner handoff in core but redesign the exposed plugin API as a smaller capability before merging the Teams behavior.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Do not merge until maintainers choose a different channel-specific lifecycle boundary that avoids a permanent Plugin SDK addition.

recommendation.title: Adopt the generic contract
recommendation.body: Approve the documented owner-coordinated reset API and merge once the remaining exact-head checks finish successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: He supplied direct lifecycle-scope changes and prior maintainer-facing review direction for this branch.
